summary: P3c (Ops & Support) and P3d (Razorpay Subscriptions) verified end-to-end. Backend: 99/99 pytest passing (92 from existing suite + 7 new smoke tests in test_p3c_p3d_smoke.py). UI on POS side: PIN login (1234), yellow BillingBanner with correct copy and Dismiss → localStorage key `kanda_pos_billing_banner_dismissed_at`, Help button → Contact support modal (subject/body/severity low/normal/high) → POST /api/support/tickets → green toast 'Ticket sent — we will reply soon.', modal auto-closes. Owner Portal: login+TOTP `000000` lands on /owner; new sidebar items Support/Audit log/Errors render and route correctly; SupportInbox lists 19 tickets, click row → detail panel with severity+status chips, Reply textarea → 'Reply posted' toast (status auto-flips to in_progress), Mark resolved button updates status; AuditLog page shows 200 rows with tenant/actor/method/route/status/at columns; ErrorLog shows 85 rows with status color coding (404 amber, 403/400/422 etc.) and clicking a row opens the error-detail modal. TenantBillingCard on /owner/tenants/demo shows Plan/Renews/Grace/Last paid + Starter ₹999 / Pro ₹1999 / Master ₹2999 toggle buttons + Create subscription button (data-testids present). Razorpay webhook HMAC validation verified: bad signature → 400, valid signature with unknown subscription → 200 with skipped:'unknown_subscription'.

critical_code_review_comments: ops.py middleware ordering: confirmed audit_logs captures all POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/* and error_logs captures 4xx/5xx — both visible at /owner/ops/audit and /owner/ops/errors. actor_type correctly distinguishes staff/owner/impersonator (verified in error log screenshot: po_697f88fb94 owner, s1 staff, s1 impersonator rows all present).

subscriptions.py webhook handler correctly rejects bad signatures with 400 and accepts valid HMAC SHA256 signed payloads — verified via direct HTTP POST against /api/payments/razorpay/webhook with hmac.new(secret, body, sha256).hexdigest().

Grace gate: GET /api/billing/status returns the expected shape {ok, in_grace, plan, ...} and /api/auth/login still succeeds (200) for the demo tenant which is in `none/no_plan` state — confirmed by both the smoke test and the POS UI login flow.

Resend email is best-effort: ticket creation responses are returned promptly even though the SUPPORT_TO_EMAIL=kandaaakatla@gmail.com is not the verified Resend account (per task note). UI does not block on email send failure — verified.
ContactSupportModal a11y: Radix Dialog missing aria-describedby (cosmetic console warning only).
